summary: Government-backed pension scheme mainly for workers in the unorganized sector, guaranteeing a fixed monthly pension after age 60.
benefits: Guaranteed monthly pension (fixed slab chosen by subscriber) after age 60, based on contributions made.
eligibility: Holds a savings bank/post office account
Not an existing income-tax payee (per current eligibility rules)
application_steps: Enroll through the bank or post office where the savings account is held
